title: Chewy Granola Cookies
description: Throw-together cookies made from granola, Biscoff spread and eggs. Chewy in the middle, crisp on the outside.
steps: Pour the granola into a large bowl. In a separate bowl, mix the Biscoff spread with the eggs until combined, then pour over the granola and stir well.
Use a pair of teaspoons to place dollops of the mixture on two baking sheets lined with greaseproof paper, spaced 2–3cm apart. Press down the tops with a fork.
Bake for 25–30 minutes or until just starting to brown on top, switching the trays halfway through.
Cool for 5 minutes on the baking sheets, then transfer to a wire rack. Keep for 3–4 days in an airtight container.
notes: Makes 10 medium-sized cookies. Per cookie estimate. Can substitute with peanut butter or chocolate hazelnut spread.
